description_en: Queries the MCP server list under a specified AgentTeams instance by using paging
description_zh: 用于分页查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 MCP 服务器列表
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-mcps --instance-id AgentTeams --max-results 20 --next-token next-token-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMcps

parameters.help_en: Optional. Fuzzy matches by instance name
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按实例名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page, used for paginated queries
parameters.help_zh: 下一页 token，用于翻页查询
parameters.name: next_token
